title: IELTS Academic Writing - Mock Test V1
description: Simulación completa del IELTS Academic Writing. Incluye el Task 1 (Reporte Gráfico) y Task 2 (Ensayo Académico).

stages.question:
Task 1: The chart below shows the percentage of households with different types of technology in the UK between 1996 and 2002.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.
stages.ai_system_prompt: ROLE: IELTS Examiner (Task 1). Assess Task Achievement, Coherence, Lexical Resource, and Grammatical Range. Do not explain everything, just return the JSON format requested with concise feedback.

stages.question:
Task 2: In many countries, the proportion of older people is steadily increasing. Does this trend have more positive or negative effects on society?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
stages.ai_system_prompt: ROLE: IELTS Examiner (Task 2). Assess Task Response, Coherence and Cohesion, Lexical Resource, and Grammatical Range and Accuracy. Ensure feedback is strict and academic.
